# London Field Atlas — Rhino mass workflow

1. Open 도시 Rhino 6/7 and download the required region ZIP(s), or download one building's .3dm from its card. The expanded city is divided into eight regions (west to east, north and south). All eight regional files share the same city origin. To edit the full city, import all eight into one Rhino document.
2. Open in Rhino 6 or 7 (also supported by Rhino 8). Downloads are saved in Rhino 6 file format. Files use metres, X east, Y north, Z up. City origin is latitude 51.51, longitude -0.106 (WGS84 local azimuthal equidistant projection).
3. Keep the origin, orientation and scale. Individual building files use a local origin at that building's anchor; the website applies that anchor automatically. Do not move a city model to a building-local origin or vice versa.
4. Models are editable meshes, not parametric NURBS/BIM. Use mesh editing tools or replace with your own geometry. For new NURBS, run Mesh and save the resulting visible mesh objects. Avoid duplicate visible surfaces and meshes.
5. Save as .3dm. In the website choose Rhino 불러오기, choose the matching target and file, check the displayed dimensions, then 지도에 적용.
6. For whole-city files preserve object names LM:<building-id>|<object-id> to preserve building selection. Other names become context. IDs: stpauls, shard, gherkin, towerbridge, tate, millennium, barbican, lloyds, westminster, abbey, museum, tower, isokon, battersea, peckham, laban, canadasquare, crossrail, navalcollege, queenshouse, observatory. Applying a regional file to the whole-city target replaces the displayed city with that region. Merge all wanted regions first. A merged full city is about 266 MB before mesh reduction, so use ReduceMesh or work on one landmark to fit the 100 MB browser limit.
7. Files remain in this browser's IndexedDB only. Clearing browser data removes them. Keep your own .3dm backup. Original restore affects the selected target only.

One unit = 1 metre. Automatic metre/mm/cm/feet/inch units are supported. Override if necessary. Models are not normalized or automatically resized. Maximum upload: 100 MB and 3 million triangles, extent 25 km.

Data: © OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright, ODbL 1.0. Central snapshot 2026-09-21, north/west extension 2026-09-30 plus Geofabrik east/south snapshot 2026-09-29. 151,407 masses over 12.51 x 10.02 km. Footprints and coordinates are geographic data; height values include 5,143 recorded heights, 60,524 estimates of 3.2 m per floor and 85,740 assumed heights or reference-informed landmark parts. Isokon retains its mapped position and orientation, with 94 editable parts for galleries, stairs, balconies, penthouse and annex. Its 14.25 m maximum height and detail dimensions are approximate. All 27 landmarks have individual Rhino 6 files. Terrain is flat; roofs and landmark forms are approximations. OSM-derived data are supplied in assets/city-data.zip (full dataset) and assets/city.json (streaming manifest) plus assets/tiles/ under ODbL. Regional Rhino geometry uses the full-resolution footprints, the same actual geometry used at every web zoom.

New landmark roof/section profiles are approximate where stated on their cards. Regional ZIPs range from 6.5 to 13.0 MB, with 24.3 to 43.9 MB uncompressed models. Each regional file has a disjoint set of objects at the shared origin; merging them does not duplicate buildings. Full context alone is 3.25 million triangles, so a complete merged import needs reduction.
